messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: Is there a way to drop a single chain from a Stan fit object?
parts:
You can't easily drop a chain from the stanfit object. But you can extract() parameters for all chains, with or without warmup, into an array and then select columns (i.e. chains) of that array.

Ben
